python3 -c "
import math

# Coordinates
sf_lat, sf_lon = 37.7749, -122.4194   # San Francisco, CA
bos_lat, bos_lon = 42.3601, -71.0589  # Boston, MA

# Haversine formula
R = 6371  # Earth's radius in km

lat1, lon1 = math.radians(sf_lat), math.radians(sf_lon)
lat2, lon2 = math.radians(bos_lat), math.radians(bos_lon)

dlat = lat2 - lat1
dlon = lon2 - lon1

a = math.sin(dlat/2)**2 + math.cos(lat1) * math.cos(lat2) * math.sin(dlon/2)**2
c = 2 * math.asin(math.sqrt(a))

distance_km = R * c
distance_mi = distance_km * 0.621371

print(f'=== Distance Calculation ===')
print(f'From: San Francisco, CA  ({sf_lat}°N, {abs(sf_lon)}°W)')
print(f'To:   Boston, MA         ({bos_lat}°N, {abs(bos_lon)}°W)')
print(f'')
print(f'Straight-line (great-circle) distance:')
print(f'  {distance_km:,.1f} km')
print(f'  {distance_mi:,.1f} miles')
"
